reason: A DSH interface plugin centered on session management through settings and conversation panels, including workspace organization, session state controls, recovery or permanent deletion, log-folder access, and context-compaction settings.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 中通过设置页和对话面板管理会话、工作区、回收站、会话状态及上下文压缩阈值。
summaries.en: Manage DSH sessions, workspaces, trash recovery, session states, log folders, and context-compaction thresholds from settings and conversation panels.

capabilities: Lists and organizes chat sessions by workspace
Provides session continue, pause, unread, read, archive, restore, and fork actions
Moves sessions to a recoverable trash area and supports permanent deletion
Opens session log directories in the system file manager
Reads and persists session, workspace, trash, unread, and context-compaction settings
